drafted_from: workflow:method-build-a-product's row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (input schema, step ids, submit shapes {run_id, changed}); no test names it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:method-build-a-product for the request: let customers of a small bakery pre-order a weekend box from the website." It walks nine method workflows in order and hands back each one's run_id and what it changed.
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Say "Run workflow:method-build-a-product" with request, in plain words, the product you want built (for example a pre-order page for a bakery).

2. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run (row workflow:method-build-a-product, input {request}) and walks its steps in order: research-plan-build, name-question-delete, contact-reality, find-the-constraints, test-a-design-against-every-case, build-the-real-thing, name-things-by-what-they-do, do-it-completely, plan-only-what-helps.
3. Each step starts one child workflow with the same request; read the {run_id, changed} it hands back and let that change shape the next step.
4. The last step, plan-only-what-helps, ends the run: read what it changed and ship the real thing it names.
